decisions.reason: As a close-to-core digital app with several models and its own page, it reflects visible investment and strategic commitment to connected practice workflows, which makes management likely to persist.
The education institute is adjacent to the firm's support and training strengths, so despite more limited public commitment than core software, management has reasons to justify and continue it.
A remote support tool fits the firm's service model and can be defended as useful infrastructure for customer support, so escalation of commitment favors retention.
The analytics dashboard had its own page and aligns closely with the firm's stated move toward digital and efficient practice management, encouraging continued backing.
The complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and likely tied to the firm's commercial positioning, so management is strongly inclined to keep it on the market.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the core software business and was only lightly presented, so it is the easiest product for management to discontinue despite prior launch costs.
